news.text: Our own website ninjaonlinereborn.com: a home page with the game's own art, screenshots and live server status, and the wiki at /wiki: every card, gear, ninjutsu, seal and stage from the game's own data, with where to get it and every chain. Breakthrough costs and bonuses like the original screens (10 fragments and 60 000 / 250 000 silver for +1, +1% trigger and +2% restrain a level). The login screen says Ninja Online Reborn, and chosen players get a glowing name (colour and sparkles picked in the control panel) on Home and in the No.1 Shinobi list.

Training and Battles exactly like the original: every boss brings its own enemies with their real strength (checked against 15 old screenshots), the story wheel uses the game's own odds; more original numbers from the game's own tables (Lucky Wheel, sage growth, border war, change country, free recruits every 3 / 2 days, a sure 5-star every 10th purple pull); war Auto-Attack works (also offline) with the original war cooldown; reincarnation shows in fights; VIP up to 23.

Late-game test round at level 100: cards stop at level 50 so Reincarnate works, Evolve only takes a real attack + defense pair and gives training pills back, country war texts, original prices and gifts for country officials, Akatsuki log text.

Elements the right way round, pets claw more often, the public server no longer restarts at night, the tutorial switched off for everyone (game update 28.0.35), English button texts (28.0.36), real strength in the Spar and Plunder list. A weekend test round with a brand-new character.
